reviews.title: RoadReady app review
reviews.text:
The RoadReady app is a popular tool designed to help parents easily log driving hours and track practice time for teenagers learning to drive. While it serves its basic purpose as a digital logbook, its tracking accuracy leaves a lot to be desired.
Pros & Cons
 Convenient Logbook: Excellent for tracking total practice time and keeping a structured record for licensing requirements.
 Inaccurate Mileage: Significantly undercounts distance, often cutting total miles driven to less than half of the actual amount.
 Flawed Scoring System: The behavior scoring system is overly sensitive and buggy—particularly the rapid acceleration score, which consistently defaults to a failing score of 2 regardless of who is driving.
The Verdict
If you only need a digital substitute for a paper driving log to track hours, RoadReady gets the job done. However, if you are relying on its automated mileage tracking or driver scoring metrics to coach your teenager, you will likely find it frustrating and unreliable.

reviews.title: App Updates Made It Worse
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app with two student drivers. For the first child it was simple and mostly a driving log. 

This summer a new app update came out. First, the data for my second child was gone. A week later with more fixes we could get it. Now the app needs location services to track. It gives driving feedback after a drive, but the metrics are inaccurate. After my son’s drives where he got nailed on his breaking and acceleration, I tried tracking my own drive being extra aware of those metrics. It gave me 2/10 scores as well. 

The worst feature is the hour tracking itself. Over 6 weeks after the major update and the math is still wrong. The minutes are being measured as if there are 100 minutes in an hour so the hours are off. Periodically more time is added to the hours to make up for it, but really, fix the math!

reviews.title: Worked well at first, but now is utterly useless
reviews.text: RoadReady worked relatively smoothly for my first 62 hours of driving, and then, as soon as they released a recent update, it has been nothing but problems, and I don’t think it has worked more than ~10% of the time since. I also hate the ads they added in the update, since the distraction they cause seems like the complete opposite of what a safe driving app should offer. Additionally, the driving behavior tracker also seems very arbitrary, as it constantly records extremely low scores for acceleration and braking, and perfect scores on speed limit behavior, regardless of how I drive. The orientation of the phone also seems to make a difference, though, so any readers take note that the top of the phone should ideally face the front of the car and be layed flat on its back in the center console, not upright on a phone holder or sideways. Finally, the constant app crashes, forced re-loggins, and its claims that I have the wrong email or password, with the fact that the ‘forgot password’ emails never show up, make this app just awful. Oh, and one more thing: It can’t even keep track accurately of the hours — it first deleted about 60 of my hours and only displayed 19 of my completed hours; then it stopped working for almost a month, and is now showing 147 hours for no reason at all and claims I have already logged the max amount of hours and am not allowed to record any more. reviews.text: This app is what the state recommends and we are basically forced to use it, but it is terrible. It is completely unreliable. It doesn’t remember you, so you have to login every time you use it. It doesn’t work with the Apple passwords app either, so you have to remember your login and password every time, which is pretty much ridiculous in this day and age. The app is constantly saying there is no connection when the phone has full connection. This causes delays when you are trying to leave so that you don’t miss logging drive time. Heaven forbid you time your departure according to the drive time, but if you do that you risk being late while waiting for this terrible app to figure out how to connect to the full connection on your phone. Just an AWFUL AWFUL user experience. The recent update that meant to add more features around driver scores and such has just made the usability of this app worse. It at least used to remember you. I really wish there was an acceptable alternative besides a manual piece of paper and pen.

reviews.title: App crashes constantly and is unusable!
reviews.text: The app crashes 90% of the time and has to get through a 3 sec ad and then a 2nd ad in order to even get to the home page successfully. Otherwise it crashes with a black blank screen.  It also sometimes opens on half the screen and then crashes to the black blank screen, or it also crashes if only 1 ad shows, which is usually the Army ad. I had to screenshot all of my son’s drives to save them, and download the drives as an affidavit just to insure we don’t loose all of his progress. We used this app 3 years ago for our other son, which was before the terrible update (apparently to a new system) and it worked great. Why take something that was simple and working and completely break it? Especially if you have to use the app to show that your kid has enough hours to get his driver’s license?! Seriously, do some testing before you roll out something so terrible, especially when you had something that worked previously.

reviews.title: Awful App
reviews.text: I have been using this app for the last almost two years to log all of my hours and within those two years this app has had more issues than anything else in my life. One of the most prevalent issues is the constant logging out of the app and password issues which forced me to have to make a whole new account and relog all my hours after my original one signed me out and wouldn’t let me back in. It almost did it a second time till I had to completely reset my password at the time to get it back. Now the app has only gotten worse with its most recent update rendering it almost unusable. Everytime I open the app it will work for a few seconds before turning the screen black in an attempt to load an ad that only properly loads sometimes and have to click the button to close the ad multiple times for it to close. I have left a total of 3 direct help requests only to receive no reply or changes.

reviews.title: Stone tablets might be easier
reviews.text: NC DMV has been recommending this app for years and I’ve used it five years through three kids. It’s a great idea and it used to work pretty well but since the May update it’s frequently broken. Every time I use it I expect a ~20% chance it’s going to work. It’s like expecting to slam your hand in the car door. Logon is frequently broken. It keeps asking me to port old kids who aren’t using it anymore. It’s now possible to log my hours as myself (like in a driving log for the parent) which is completely pointless. It regularly loses/ deletes drives. It gives inconsistent feedback from the accelerometer (two similar drives can come back as 10/10 or 5/10). AND support is completely unresponsive; I’ve e-mailed support and gotten no answer. I’m seriously considering going to paper driving logs for my last child.

reviews.title: Hardly Ever Works!
reviews.text: This app is such a headache! It is so full of bugs and half the time just doesn’t work at all. It is a gamble day to day whether I can even log in or not before it crashes! I constantly have to keep outside logs because I can’t get in to enter a driving session.  There are many drives where I need to use my phone for Google Maps and this app doesn’t allow you to use your phone for anything else in order for it to track and log a drive. So I just have to log my drive elsewhere and then hope I remember to add it to the app at a later date. It also doesn’t allow you to add drive sessions same-day, so again, I have to keep track of my drive sessions elsewhere and log them all at a later time. It’s immensely frustrating and inefficient! I wish we were not forced to use such a horrible and undependable app!

reviews.title: The new version is unusable
reviews.text:
I am extremely frustrated with the recent changes to the RoadReady app. It has become nearly unusable for our family.

Almost every time we log in, we have been logged out of our accounts. Even worse, at least half the time the driving hours that were previously logged have disappeared.

The latest issue is the most concerning. One of my twins has now been changed to an “adult” driver in the app, which means he can no longer log any driving hours. The problem is that he had already completed and logged all 60 required hours before this happened. Those hours have now disappeared, and because he is classified as an adult driver, there is no way to recover or continue logging hours.

This leaves us with no proof that he completed the required hours and no way to add additional hours if needed. This is an unacceptable flaw in an app that families rely on to meet legal driving requirements.

Please restore his previously logged hours, correct his account so he is classified appropriately, and address these ongoing login and data-loss issues. I would appreciate a prompt response, as this directly affects his ability to obtain his driver’s license. His birthday is next week. There is no way to get in touch with anyone from customer service.

reviews.title: I hate this app so much
reviews.text: This a a requirement for my son's driver's license. The older app wasn't anything fancy but it always worked. No issues opening, no issues recording a drive, it was fine. Then they went and updated it to this mess. I have successfully logged in to the app about four times now. Unsuccessful attempts? 20? 25? It logs you out constantly and then it won't let you log back in. My son can't log in on his side. So I can only record drives when I'm with him. And now it requires all this tracking data while driving. All that is annoying enough. But entering a manual log never works either. I have emailed and written numerous times about the issues I and my son have experienced and have received no response. I cannot wait to be done with this garbage app. Terrible experience.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: They updated this app atleast 3 times when I started using it the first time I used the app it was regular and normal and would save my progress. Once the first update happen it took about 2 weeks to start working and it restarted the whole app and so now all my progress just didn’t seem legitimate. Once the third update happen I had already have almost all my hours done until it erased half of it since it updated for more “accurate” and better grading judgement, but I drove well and it showing as if i had sped and I don’t even speed and excessive braking when I would break because of people around me. Of course the app cannot see it so it seems like all that but it just inaccurate it should just stay to track mileage and the time. It’s very useless and I wouldn’t recommend this to no one I’d just find another app or go back to basic with the book.

reviews.title: Completely unreliable after update
reviews.text: This was simple and worked great before the most recent update. After the update, the app constantly fails to log hours. Today, we logged in and my daughter’s app reported 7 fewer hours of logged drive time than yesterday, right as she was about to pass her mandatory 50 hours. She is distraught to have lost all these hours and we can’t even figure out which days are missing so we can manually re-log the hours. If I had known how much of a hassle this app was, we would have used a paper and pencil log. We’ve been unable to apply any of the fixes road ready suggests because when she signed up for the app before the update, they just had her make a student account linked to my husband’s email and now we can’t seem to update contact info or use their migration feature.

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: I used this app for two of my sons driving logs and while it was basic, it worked. Halfway through logging my third sons driving they decided to update the app to something almost completely useless. First, we were locked out of the app for a few weeks while they fixed multiple admin issues. Once it finally started working we found that several precious hours were missing. I was able to add the logs back in but then after using it for a few weeks, I started the app one day to find that all progress is gone and my son is no longer listed as a student with the app. This app has literally one job, to log driving hours and it can’t even do that. I have reached out multiple times for assistance and received no response. Don’t waste your time.

reviews.title: Migration made this app even more useless
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for two older children learning to drive in previous years. It was very basic but it also worked for the most part.  Recently, we had to migrate to a newer version of the app, basically. It’s totally useless. Can’t log a current drive because of constant network errors. It logs you out every couple of days. So, you’re forced to only log previous drives. If I’m making a list of drives in a note, then the app isn’t helpful. Also, when trying to log previous drives, it often takes more than one try and doesn’t log night hours accurately.
It has become a total cluster, unfortunately, when I was weeks away from being done having any student drivers in the house.

Also, really weird, but the ads streaming at the bottom sometimes flips to porn sites. Just odd for an app used by parents and teens.

reviews.title: Keeps logging me out and lost all of my hours
reviews.text: So I completed segment 1 & 2 using this app just fine. Recently though, it’s been extremely faulty. As many others using this app, I found that it keeps logging me out, scraping some of my hours, and has difficulty logging hours. The cherry on top urging me to write this review is that it logged me out of a two hour drive session only for me to log back in and see that it’s apparently telling me that I have zero hours logged. This app was once so simple to use and guided me through my journey towards getting my license, but with the new updates it’s just horrible. Don’t know what they were thinking with these new „improvements“ but they are just plain bad. Honestly, they’re just nerfing their own app! Word of advice: just manually log your hours on paper or use a different app.

reviews.title: Terrible App!
reviews.text:
This app has been a terrible experience. I don't understand how it's supposed to be used for my child to log their supervised driving hours so they can qualify for their driver's license.

We never had any issues with this app when my older child used it a few years ago, but for at least the past week, it has been completely unusable. The app crashes every time we try to use it. We can't log in, we can't record driving hours, and we can't do anything. At this point, you're better off using the paper logbook from the DMV than relying on this app.

It's frustrating because this app is supposed to help students track their driving progress, but it doesn't even work. We've tried everything we can think of, including uninstalling and reinstalling the app, resetting passwords, and following the recommended troubleshooting steps. I've also contacted customer support and haven't received a response from anyone.

This is really disappointing. The developers need to fix these issues because families are expected to rely on this app. Please do better and make the app reliable again.


***Update***
The app still has not improved. It has now deleted almost three weeks of driving time. No response from support team on fixing issues. If we were to turn in these times to move to the next level. They need to figure out something.

reviews.title: Non-functional
reviews.text: I remembered this app from when my oldest child started driving but a lot has changed. I still had my old login info but it didn’t work so I had to create a new account. It didn’t give me the option of adding my driver without my child creating their own account and linking it to mine so the first few drives were logged as if I as the parent were driving. Definitely don’t have a use for that. And cannot migrate those drives over to my child now that his account is set up. So that is annoying and inconvenient. Then after a week of using the app without issue, tried to log our drive this morning only to find that the app logged me out and my login information no longer works. It doesn’t recognize my email. I updated the app and the issue persists. Do not use this app. It’s terrible. Nothing but problems.

reviews.title: Recent overhaul update made app even more buggy
reviews.text: Have been using app 5 months since son got permit in March. Saw so many poor reviews and thought maybe people have older phones are just not technically inclined. There were occasional issues with rides not saving and freezes. In middle of June they did a complete overhaul of app and ever since the app is almost not worth using would rather use an excel sheet to track than the utter mess the app has become. Have to log in almost every day to record rides, it does not save properly, you manually have to put in rides sometimes and that is more cumbersome than previous version, you have to have two accounts one for you and your driver and they don’t seem to sync all the time. But the biggest frustration is recently whole weeks of record drives have just disappeared, I have backed up driving record weekly and this week when I went to back up my son was missing 15 hours of total drive time over last two weeks just vanished from his log messages to support to fix have received no response. So what’s the point of app not if you can’t trust it to maintain accurate logs????

reviews.title: “Update”
reviews.text:
Okay, so this app was not great before, it was essentially just a timer that you started and stopped. But you know what? That was all we needed to record driving time. Then, the update happened. Wow, where to start? The update did the following:
-switched my daughters name into my name
-didn’t correctly import all previous information
-doesn’t allow you to select night drive or day drive, it just (wrongly) guesses based on time of day
-doesn’t immediately add a drive to the total without rebooting the app
-displays hours in decimal format incorrectly, so 7 hours and 53 minutes is shown as 7.53 hours
-requires the phone to be mounted and still during the drive, leaves the screen on the entire time, and drains the battery in record time. Seriously, I have the latest iPhone and it drained about 30% of the battery in a one hour drive. This also makes it impossible to use the phone while my student daughter is driving
-takes forever to load unskippable ads which must be viewed in order to complete and log a drive
-gives “scores” based on acceleration, braking, etc. but as I mentioned, if the phone isn’t rigidly mounted somewhere the scores are all wrong and will undermine driver confidence

I feel like there’s more, but I’m done writing this review. My DMV recommended this app, but you would probably be better served by a notebook in the car. At least before it functioned for its intended use.

reviews.title: Upgrade lost data, drains phone
reviews.text: The recent update removed both of my student drivers and after several weeks I’ve given up on getting access to their drives. I lost over 6 hours of driving logs in the middle of drivers ed. I emailed support for help retrieving my data with no response. I gave up, got my account working, and tried using the new app so I could at least continue logging hours, but the new features are a step backwards. Your screen must constantly be on, and the phone must be stable at all times (pray you don’t have potholes) because the app attempts to track speed, acceleration, sharp turns, sudden stops etc. The data it gathered was not at all accurate, and the app now makes my phone heat up and drains my battery. It was a nice app before, but the update killed it for me.

reviews.title: App is so bad after update.
reviews.text: So first off, I want to say the app wasn’t bad before they updated it. The only annoying thing was the ads, but that was so easily to not annoy you, but they updated the app and it logged me out, and didn’t let me log back in, so I had to create a whole new account and relog my hours. Which isn’t bad, but wanna know the worst part? If you start a drive and that cuts into their “nighttime” hours it doesn’t count as night, it only counts as day. Which wouldn’t be so bad, but this quite literally fix that with a couple tweaks. And their new review of your drive is annoying too, because they don’t know what’s happening on the road, so that whole idea is terrible. If you’re thinking of getting this app, I highly recommend you just manually log it with the book they give you from the DMV. I repeat DONT USE THIS APP.

reviews.title: Unfortunate Update
reviews.text:
I used to love the ease and simplicity of this app. We used it to keep track of required driving hours for our two oldest kids when they were learning, and we never had any major issues. It was simple to start a new drive or log an old one. Unfortunately, the updated version has been very frustrating and ineffective at logging hours. 

First, the app requires the kids and parents to have separate accounts. Logging in and navigating the interface is more complicated than it used to be. The worst part is that I get error messages when trying to start a new drive or log an old drive, so the app is not keeping track of all the drives. 

Also, if I have to edit drive times (which is often because of the errors) I can only choose 15 minute intervals. 

Lastly, the “required amount of driving” is different than our state’s requirements. The app used to have an overall 45-hour requirement, 15 of which needed to be nighttime. Now it is an overall 50-hour requirement, with only 10 being nighttime. This is not that big of a deal as long as I have a record of all the driving, but I preferred the hours that coordinated with our state’s requirements. 

Please fix the app so it will record the drives!

reviews.title: My hours are lost
reviews.text: For the first few months using this from December to July, it was fine. I finally just got my 31 hours so I can go take segment two and I go to open my app so I can go drive and log my hours and it won’t let me back in and it logged me out and I’m like OK so I try to login with my password that I know is correct and it keeps denying it. I try to reset my password and it doesn’t work and it lets me in, but it makes me like a teacher account so I can’t do anything and I try again and it says it’s signed out so I have to wait like another day and it gives me one tribe before it’s timed out and I can’t use it like I’m logged. I’m locked out. I’ve emailed them multiple times. Nothing has been done about it and it’s really a disappointing because hundreds of thousands of people across the country use this app and it’s really disappointing that they can’t fix anything or take accountability.

reviews.title: They’ve ruined this app!
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for four of my children as they’ve gotten driving hours. For the first 3 1/2, it was awesome! You stayed logged in, you could turn it on quickly, record previous drives easily, etc. 
Now, it won’t let you log in most of the time. If you do get in, you have to watch an ad, then it just spins & spins. So, you can’t record as you drive. Every so often I can log in, and then, when I try to record the last drive (or last 4) I couldn’t get it to record, I can’t record the exact time, because it only does 15 minute increments & then, it gives an error message & doesn’t save the drive. It’s a waste of time!

I’m stuck halfway through on my son’s driving hours, but the changes they’ve made make this app so frustrating & not useful for recording driving time.

reviews.title: Horrible, why does DMV use this?
reviews.text: This app is absolutely  horrific, to say the least. Most the time you cannot even log in, whether it’s because you get shown a loading screen or your login simply just stops working. And when you can log in, it doesn’t even let you log your driving? As a 15 year old kid just trying to log my reading because I’m legally required to and have to use this app, why don’t they make it better? If you love constant bugs and glitches and endless BS, this apps for you. Has given me nothing but an everlasting headache that only seems to creep up when I see the app icon on my screen. Anyone know what that condition could be? If your in a similar position as I am, or are reading this as one who is soon to become a driver, the moment they ask you at the dmv if you’d like to log your driving on paper or the app, cut those trees down all day. I live an hour and a half from the dmv but as soon as I’m on my way to get my level 2, best believe I’m leaving the dmv with a big relief off my chest…. And maybe a sore throat from all the yelling. Dont download!

reviews.title: June 2026 update is terrible
reviews.text: Before June 2026 this was a clunky but fairly simple app that let you log your kids’ drives in real time or log an old drive, and automatically noted if they were day or night based on the time. It was a little glitchy but fairly simple.  I used it for kid 1 and came back for kid 2. After the update, it’s awful. To use it you have to have location services on, even to log an old drive (!!). You have to connect to a RoadReady account for your child, this is not optional. It’s about 25% effective so far to log the drive without an error. It defaults to me (the parent) as the driver so guess who I keep logging drives to?  And best of all you can’t navigate “back” so you have to close out of the app every time it starts spinning which is 75%+ of the times I try to use it. I could go on… Only 2 weeks left until my kid takes his test so I’ll bear it out but NOT using it again for kid 3.

reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.text:
After the recent update, the app has became annoying to use. When I tried to start a drive today it asked me to log in with my email when I’d already started the car. Unlocking the app is a huge inconvenience and I’m not particularly worried about anyone messing with my hours. Also, during the update period where the app was unusable I had taken some drives and went back into log them when the problem seemed over. It was not. I kept trying to log it and hit refresh but it never ended up working until I saw my hours earlier today with an extra 17+ hours added. Might just be a user error on my part but I then spent 48 minutes of my day deleting all of the logged drives that had glitched in. I’ve also had troubles in the past with the timer stopping because of some issue with the app. 

Not worth the struggle personally.

reviews.title: Keep backing up log
reviews.text: This app works until it doesn’t. I’ve used it for two prior children but it has gotten worse recently. I sometimes can’t log into the app, and sometimes it fails to save a drive in a log. If you use the app, I strongly urge you to download a driving log after every drive. Here is an example. My child is required to drive 50 hours minimum. She currently has 47.5 hours logged in the Road Ready app. Her driving test is five days away. I currently can’t access her driving log or any info. When I log into the app it says I’ve successfully logged in, but then it just spins on a white screen. No chance of accessing her data. I can’t log in under her email or my own. I’ve had so many problems with this app that I would strongly urge you to find any other driving log resource. It used to work much more smoothly. Now? It is completely unreliable.

reviews.title: Ruined by Update
reviews.text: I have been using this app to log my hours for the past two or so years; it worked fine and did what it was supposed to do. However, fifteen minutes before I went to take my road test, I checked the app only to realize that it had completely changed. With the new update, any hours previously logged were deleted and wiped from my account, which could’ve made me ineligible for testing. Luckily, the instructor had been dealing with issues regarding RoadReady for the past week or so and allowed me to take the test with a parent/guardian signature to verify I had gotten all the required hours. Even so, it’s absolutely ridiculous to update an app and not transfer over data linked to an account, not to mention that support took hours to return a phone call. Very frustrating and disappointing.

reviews.title: Update destroys usability
reviews.text:
The app was good in its previous form. It would occasionally not continue tracking a drive, but for the most part it was stable. I used it to track the permit and post license driving for my son and half of the permit driving for my daughter. 

All was well, then they updated the app. I see what they were trying to do, but it is a terrible failure. The amount of work to set up my account on an app I was already using was excessive. Now the app logs me out as a user after a couple of drives, won’t allow me to use Face ID for login even though I’ve selected it, and since yesterday, won’t even finish the login process. Now I can’t get to the point when I can log a drive, which is the only reason this app exists. The app was not even close to being stable enough to release the update. 

I have never reviewed an app before, but the developers need to understand that you completely messed up with the update, it has rendered your app less than usable. Regardless of my feelings about the 60 hour requirement levied by NC for permit driving, the ability to track drives and print out the log is necessary. This update was not ready for game time. Please fix.

reviews.title: Broken as of v3.4
reviews.text:
This app used to be great. It was simple, worked reliably, and did exactly what it was supposed to do. Since the version 3.4 update, which overhauled the UX and UI, changed the authentication system, and introduced separate parent and child account requirements, it has become a constant frustration.

The app now logs me out every time I open it. Face ID was set up correctly but does not work, so I am forced to log in manually via email each time. It then repeatedly tries to authenticate my child's account, who is now a full time driver and no longer needs that account, just so I can reach the screen to start a drive with my next child learning to drive. Frequently, I cannot record a drive at all because the app gets stuck on a "your information is being verified" screen.

All I need is a simple, reliable way to log driving hours, which is exactly what this app used to provide with my son. Now that I’m training my daughter I am looking for an alternative.

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text:
Initially, we had no issues and the app worked as expected. However, we then began experiencing repeated login problems, and the app stopped allowing us to log driving hours, either for new trips or previous trips. Every attempt results in an error message.
Even more concerning, there have been multiple occasions where we completed a drive only to discover that the app had stopped working during the trip, meaning none of the driving time was recorded.
We also continue to have difficulty logging in and often have to reset the password nearly every time we use the app.
Based on our experience, I would not consider the app reliable enough to accurately track required driving hours. I would strongly recommend keeping a separate written log of all driving time to ensure hours are properly documented and not lost due to app failures.

reviews.title: horrible
reviews.text: I had to get 60 hours of driving in order to get my drivers license. After 8 months I finally got my 60 hours and still kept on logging to get to over 60 hours. Next thing I know, I am logged out of the app. I tried to log in with my email and password (which I know are correct because I wrote them down and logged in perfectly before) and it didn’t work. After searching up what I can do to hopefully get it back, it told me to delete the app and try again. After doing this, it didn’t work again and I tried to do “forgot password” option to reset my password and get my data back, but once I made a new password it brought me to a completely blank page with NONE of my data whatsoever. Now I don’t know what to do. My license test is in less then a month and I don’t have any data of my driving hours.

reviews.title: Fire the Developers. Update more buggy than a mosquito convention
reviews.text:
When I downloaded this app two years ago when my daughter was taking drivers Ed, it worked just fine. Simple, no issues. Now my son it’s taking driver’s ed and up until two weeks ago, the app worked fine. Then there was an update and the app ceased being able to log a drive, producing an error message when I tried to do so. Then I uninstalled the app and reinstalled it. Even worse problems. It wouldn’t let me log in. Then it said I was logged in, only to take me right back to the login screen. I logged a complaint thinking that surely the devs would correct the problem with an imminent update. Nope. Still has issues logging in. I had to make an “instructor account” and add my teenagers to the account via invitation. Then my son could login but I couldn’t. But not for long. Two days later, HE couldn’t login either. Then I was able to login briefly this afternoon, but now when I tried to login again, we are back to the “yes you successfully logged in, and we’ll just take you right back to the login page instead of actually opening the app. 

This app is terrible, no longer works, and now I need a way to pull all of my son’s data out of the app and use something else to track his hours. The negative reviews are real. Don’t you dare use this app. Instead find a solution that actually works.

reviews.title: New update no good
reviews.text: I used road ready two years ago for my first child, and I found the app so easy to use. It could be used off-line, I could easily designate which child this was for. Now with the new update, I have to sign in every single time, and the app doesn’t work well unless you have full bars.. In addition, you can no longer designate which child is driving unless you have the child sign up with their email as well.. What happens if a child doesn’t have an email address? It just looks like I’m logging my own hours. I think it has to do with the AI. The app now uses to track how well you drove. But to me, that’s not the point of the app. The point of the app is to record the driving time, it’s the real person who they will train with who is supposed to be giving you live feedback. I partner that doesn’t even know how to drive. Please fix these problems, I really did enjoy the app before you changed all of this

reviews.title: Data lost and no support response
reviews.text:
The recent update has been incredibly frustrating and has completely undermined the purpose of this app.

My son had accumulated nearly 35 hours of supervised driving time in RoadReady before the update. After being forced to switch to a student account in order to continue using the app, all of those hours disappeared. Years of driving records and documentation were essentially wiped out with no warning and no clear way to transfer or recover the data.

For an app whose primary function is tracking legally required driving hours, losing that much information is unacceptable. Parents and students depend on these records to meet licensing requirements. Those 35 hours represent real driving time and cannot simply be recreated after the fact.

What makes this even more frustrating is that users were apparently forced into the new account structure without adequate safeguards to protect existing data. Preserving user records should have been a top priority before rolling out such a significant change.

I contacted customer support over a week ago seeking assistance and have yet to receive any response. Losing critical driving records is bad enough, but being ignored when trying to resolve the issue only adds to the frustration.

Until there is a reliable way to recover lost driving logs and responsive customer support for affected users, I cannot recommend this app to other families. Keep backups of your driving logs elsewhere, because apparently an update can wipe out dozens of

reviews.title: Warning!!! Do not use!!
reviews.text:
User beware! This is an update and I am extremely disappointed with my experience using the Road Ready app. My child’s driving logs, which represented all of his completed required driving hours, appear to have been lost, leaving him unable to move forward with his driving test and licensing process.

What is even more concerning is the lack of customer support. I have reached out by email at least 10 times and have not received a single response or any assistance in resolving the issue.

For an app that users rely on to track important licensing requirements, this level of reliability and customer service is unacceptable. Based on my experience, I strongly recommend keeping a paper log of all driving instead of this app. Losing access these records can have significant consequences, and there appears to be little to no support available when problems arise

reviews.title: Worst app on the whole store
reviews.text: The one thing the programmers of this app ever succeeded at in life was making the least reliable program for logging driving hours. After the latest update, trying to log my past drives became an unnecessarily complicated process. You now have to manually enter a start and end time from a drop down menu that goes in 15-minute intervals starting from 1 am. Truly something only a sadist could ever come up with. But if you thought that was the only issue, then bless your heart. In order to waste your time even more, you now have to enter the distance you drove, which was not a requirement in the previous app. And to top it all off, this app now requires your location in order to log drives, even for past drives (otherwise you’ll be stuck on a loading screen for hours). Additionally, transferring accounts from the previous version of the app to the current one is such a chore… if you are a teen then your parent account has to invite you to the app via an email the app sends out. It took me a good 10 minutes of waiting and resending the invite before I realized that all the emails were arriving in the junk folder (where this app belongs). Until that teen account is linked, the app is literally useless because it doesn’t show your hours at all. This is the first time I’ve ever seen an app require two phones to have it installed in order for the program to actually work, and I do have to say that it is an extremely stupid concept.

reviews.title: Lost entire log ALL 50 HOURS DAY OF EXAM
reviews.text:
I had no issues with this app until today, the day of my road test(50 hours total).
 I opened the app this morning only to find it had logged me out(I believe as a result of an update I was unaware of). I attempted to log back in but my prior password refused to work, and even then the password reset was unbelievably confusing. When I thought I had finally managed to log back in, the entire app interface had changed and none of my hours where there. Even when I tried to add my previous email, it stated I could not add it. I couldn’t locate a log-out option and was forced to delete that account, possibly deleting my original account in the process. I contacted support yet they never responded and I was unable to recover my log. In the end I lost all 50 hrs and had to reschedule my exam. I highly recommend using a different app, printing out your log every few weeks, or just using the paper logs. Save yourself the struggle and disaster I experienced using this app. And the people who made this app need to actually think before they send out updates, like maybe sending everyone their logs just in case they lose them?!

reviews.title: Road ready.
reviews.text: I was at 27 hours and I am scheduled to start segment two next month. I have emailed RoadReady about the issue, no response. I would like to mention I tried countless times to somehow get my data back. But ended up deleting it all. I have receipts of me completing 27 hours from weekly reports from RoadReady. I have wrote that down and went to pencil and paper. If you’re scared that your time is lost it isn’t!! The Secretary of State suggests this app, and basically tells you it’s the better option, because of the crash I have a feeling that the will be offering some time of screenshots of time or road ready weekly report emails because of the crash they can’t just not do anything. I would suggest writing that down in a notebook, spreadsheet, or notes app that you have completed a number of hours and have receipts. Then continue to write them down on paper. I don’t have the patience or time to mess with this app any longer, I’d suggest ditching the app for good and starting fresh! Great day!

reviews.title: Impressed they did this bad
reviews.text: I would give 0 stars but I can’t. This type of app is so simple to make, yet they somehow make it horrible, I’m actually impressed. So I updated this app recently and tried to log in, I forgot my password so I tried a few. I got them all wrong so it said my account was locked for a few minutes(apparently a few minutes is an hour but I guess it’s fine) after a few days of trying to reset my password, I see I have to update it again. I’m able to log in now but what do I see? A horrible simple app turned into an even worse app. It has way too much stuff(like why are there lessons? I went to drivers ed for a reason). To add onto that, my hours were deleted. I thought, it’s fine I’ll manually put them in. Why are they asking for the miles I drove? I guess and put 10 because I’m logging day hours and can’t put more or it will log some at night. Apparently these big brained coders didn’t pass kindergarten math because they thought 10 hours = 4 hours. In conclusion, this app is absolutely atrocious and is way overly coded for what it’s for. I think a toddler could do better. To the dev team, do better, don’t try to “show off” your “skills.”

reviews.title: From Very useful to ABSOLUTELY HORRIBLE
reviews.text: I got my permit and was so excited to hear that there was a useful app to log in all my hours. But little did I know what would happen next…..  so basically fast forward I was logging in my hours effectively and easily. Then a few months into having my permit I went to log in my hours and it said error? So I tried again and the same thing happened… the next day I wake up to find there was an update. But it LOGGED ME OUt and I know that wasn’t a big deal so I just decided to create a new account since I forgot all my passwords and remembered my hours. But then I went on the new update and it is truly TERRIBLE I would usually just login that I drove 2 hrs in the day easy peasy. But NOWWW u have to have the EXACT date,time,hrs,road type, miles!! And I’m not taking all my  precious time doing that. Even though in the old update had that it was ALLL OPTIONAL!! so don’t waste ur storage with this app and simply just do it on the paper or on ur notes app or something other than this! XOXO not a Karen

reviews.title: Absolutely horrid
reviews.text: I would never recommend this app to anyone in a million years. I’m a student driver and was told by the DMV to use the Road Ready App to log driving hours. I was also given a manual log that was optional to use but I felt that wasn’t necessary since the app was more convenient. If I knew then what I knew now, I would’ve manually written down every single driving hour I had rather than entering it into this poorly designed app. There was an update recently and this caused widespread issues with logging in, and viewing their hours. Earlier as I was attempting to login to the app, it would not let me, it didn’t even let me change my password. I passed my driving test today and if this app didn’t crash down, I could’ve accessed and uploaded my driving hours so that I can officially get my license. But because of the dilemma this app caused, I will now have to redo every single one of my required driving hours THAT I ALREADY COMPLETED. I suggest that the Road Ready app developers or whoever manages the technical aspects of this application should identify this widespread technical error and implement a solution IMMEDIATELY.

reviews.title: Migration Nightmare
reviews.text:
This app has completely failed our family at the worst possible time. We received a migration email with a temporary password, but the app throws a “No internet connection” error on both my iPhone and iPad — even after fresh installs, network resets, and trying cellular data only.
I have no access to my daughter’s driving log (68+ hours with required night hours) and her DMV road test is Monday morning. Support has been silent so far.
The app stores everything server-side with no web access, so when the login breaks during a forced migration, users are completely locked out. This is unacceptable for a tool parents rely on for official driving requirements.
If you value your data and need reliability, look for another option or stick to paper logs. RoadReady desperately needs to fix their migration process and connection issues.

reviews.title: Was working fine but now can’t access log
reviews.text: Everything was working fine until I 3 days ago.  I attempted to document my child’s last 45 minutes of night driving. All of a sudden the log stopped working and the log would no longer accept any more hours. Next the log logged me out and would not accept my password or a password reset to get me back into the log. I have contacted Customer Service and they sent me a password reset, which did not work. The phone number. Included in the email goes to a call center in Ohio about driving, which is not helpful about the app because everyone I spoke to attempted to set me up for driving. I need to get into the app to access the log to print it for my son’s teacher in Virginia. I don’t want to complain, I need help.

reviews.title: Genuinely horrible
reviews.text: I’m a teen that is trying to finish up my hours and I haven’t drove in a bit. My parents are getting emails about the app switching and that I have to now use a temporary password to handle the transfer of my account to the new app. And of course it doesn’t work and I keep getting locked out and then it keeps making me invite new drivers even though I have already an account. I set up my account under my parents email but I can’t have 2 accounts because of course. It’s just so confusing and frustrating. I am pretty sure I have to log into my account under my parents email then invite myself by my email then go to the app and logout to re login to a different account under my email. I hate this app so much they shouldn’t have reset and changed I the whole layout at all.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work at all.
reviews.text: I got a new phone so it logged me out and every time I put the correct email and password in it wouldn’t work. Also today it was say there was a error “500” and every time I try to log my hours it didnt let me so I swiped out and turned off my phone and that didn’t work so then I went to the AppStore to update it and it logged me out again and passwords aren’t working so I pressed “forgot password” but the right email in then it sent my email and then asked me for a text via text message and it never sent so asked to send my verification to my email and it never loaded and just stayed on car driving or a “loading screen”. They need to fix this I shouldn’t not have to log in this much and have it delete all of my hours. It also has never saved my password for this app so I also cannot look at that. Please fix the app and I do not recommend getting this app for student driving or other things like that.

reviews.title: HORRIBLE!!!!!!!!!!!!!! DO NOT USE!
reviews.text: I absolutely loved the idea of being able to log my hours digitally UNTIL THEY UPDATED IT!!!!! It is absolutely not user friendly and switched so that you needed a teacher account to log ANY hours as a student… I originally set up an account, followed the instructions and added a parent email so it would notify us when I hit 59 hours and could take the drivers exam. It has been glitching out for the last two days bugging me to do an update so naturally I did it, figuring I’d log back in and everything would be fine with new features like every other app…NOPE!!! It deleted EVERY SINGLE HOUR I HAD (40 hours by the way) and lost all of my progress now I have to log the time into a DIFFERENT app and when it saved my account IT USED MY MOMS EMAIL AND REGISTERED HER AS A DRIVING INSTRUCTOR so I can’t access ANY of the information like my permit number or hours since I need an invitation to get back into the app. SO ANNOYED AND SHAME ON THEM!

reviews.title: Deletes previous drives
reviews.text:
I’ve used this for two teens now, and the problems haven’t changed. Drives disappear in multiple different  scenarios… the main ones:

one: logging a current drive - sometimes it will decide to cancel/reload, even if the drive was ongoing and the app had not been closed. (Why would it cancel after 5 mins sometimes - when it will log an accidental 14 hour one that I forgot to stop at other times?)

Two: there have been times I’ve had to add previous drives (such as when he drives with someone else). These are FREQUENTLY removing previous drives on the same day. I don’t know if it’s an overwriting issue if it can only have two a day or something, but it’s ridiculous that with no warning a new drive deletes an old one. I think it’s just a glitch, because I can eventually get a third or fourth drive to show up, but not before I have to reenter some of them multiple times. It is UNRELIABLE unless you have a backup chart - and then what’s the point? 

I really like it when it works - but if you’re expecting it to work and don’t notice it’s not keeping all the drives - it causes a big problem getting their time in!
